svg.title: SELLABLE — 03 / 03 — AGENTIC COMMERCE · RAZORPAY AI BUILDATHON

g.text: An AI agent that can shop for you and structurally cannot
spend your money: it may only propose a SKU and a quantity,
and twelve deterministic rules decide what happens next.

svg.text: THE MODEL IS OUT OF THE MONEY PATH
{ sku, qty } only — no amount field
SHA-256 binding over cart, quote, amount
state written to disk before every dispatch
